questions.question:
**Select the correct indirect speech form of the given sentence.**

Mother said to me, "I'm worried about your safety."

options.text: Mother told me that she had been worried about my safety.
Mother told me that she was worried about my safety.
Mother said she is worried about your safety.
Mother said that I was worrying about your safety.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'Mother told me that she was worried about my safety.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Direct Speech. As per the question, we have to change it into Indirect Speech. 
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
 
• In the given sentence the reporting verb has an object. Hence, 'said to' will be changed into 'told'. 
 
• Comma and inverted commas will be removed. 
 
• The conjunction 'that' will be added.
 
• **'I' **will be changed into **'she'** because the **first person pronoun**s are changed according to the **subject** of the** reporting verb.**
 
• '**am**' will be changed into '**was**'.
 
• '**your**' will be changed into '**my**' because the **second-person pronouns** are changed according to the **object** of the **reporting verb.**
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 
 
 

**Correct Sentence:__** *Mother told me that she was worried about my safety.*

questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Give the child a nourishing diet.

options.text: The child should be given a nourishing diet.
The child was given a nourishing diet.
The child must have given a nourishing diet.
The child is given a nourishing diet

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'The child should be given a nourishing diet.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the Active Voice. As per the given question we have to change the sentence into Passive Form. 
 
• The transformation of these kinds of sentences is:
 
 
• The given sentence is an example of **an imperative sentence.**
 
• The notion of the given sentence is the suggestion.
 
 
• **V₁**** + Object. (Active Voice)**
 
• **Subject (Objective case) + should + be + V3. (Passive Voice)**
 
 
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *Help the poor. (Active Voice)*
 
• *The poor should be helped. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• Hence, as per the above rule, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 
 
 

**Correct Sentence:__** *The child should be given a nourishing diet.*

questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

She gifted me a beautiful handbag.

options.text: I am gifted a beautiful handbag by her.
I was gifted a beautiful handbag by her.
I have been gifted a beautiful handbag by her.
I am being gifted a beautiful handbag by her.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'I was gifted a beautiful handbag by her.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Active Voice. As per the given question, we have to change it into Passive Voice. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + V2 + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (objective case) + was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)*
 
• *They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'She'.​​
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'me'. 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
 
• And 'gifted' will be changed into 'was gifted'. 
 
• Lastly, the preposition 'by' will be added. 

 

Correct Sentence:__ *I was gifted a beautiful handbag by her.*

questions.question:
**Sentence of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. They can help you to decide the right products for you.

B. Advertisements can be extremely useful if they are honest.

C. Teenagers are especially vulnerable to such advertisements.

D. However, some advertisements may be harmful as they try to befool you.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**BADC**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'. 
 
 
• **Sentence B **will be the first sentence because it is an introductory sentence talking about the advertisements.
 
• **Sentence A** will be the next sentence because it tells us what advertisements can do.
 
• **Sentence D** will be the next sentence because it further tells us how harmful advertisements can be.
 
• Lastly,** Sentence C **will be used.
 
• Thus, the correct sequence is:
 
 
• **B**: Advertisements can be extremely useful if they are honest.
 
• **A**: They can help you to decide the right products for you.
 
• **D**: However, some advertisements may be harmful as they try to befool you.
 
• **C**: Teenagers are especially vulnerable to such advertisements.

 
 
 
 
 

**Correct Passage:__** *Advertisements can be extremely useful if they are honest. They can help you to decide the right products for you. However, some advertisements may be harmful as they try to befool you. Teenagers are especially vulnerable to such advertisements.*
